definitions: If a description or criticism applies to you, you should accept it.
If something is true about you, you should acknowledge it.
examples: He got upset when I said some people here are lazy, but if the shoe fits, wear it.
She was offended by the comment, but her friend told her, 'if the shoe fits, wear it.'
lemma: if the shoe fits, wear it
synonyms: if the cap fits, wear it
source: if the shoe fits, wear it
